budget_unit: equal count of fact-language items; token cost is not equal
candidate_scope: 138 same-language original documents; only development documents changed
frequency_deficit: development query field frequency multiplied by (1 + missing_or_partial_fields/5), deterministic hash tie-break; uses no query target identity
shortage: count missing/partial fields in each place-language document, using AI-reviewed gap table
warning: No statistical claim; relevance, language, and facts require human review; multiple relevant places possible; independent test queries not used.
